title: Vert.x hangs indefinitely on close if websocket client does not receive CLOSE frame from server

comments.body: Note that this issue is resolved in 5.0.0 with the new `shutdown()` behavior in the client, but it would be great to have a solution in 4.5.x since it will surely take some time for Quarkus to adopt 5.x.
we have a timeout for this, but this timeout only starts when it receives the close frame, I think I will change it to start when it emits the close frame instead

> we have a timeout for this, but this timeout only starts when it receives the close frame, I think I will change it to start when it emits the close frame instead
